name: agencyestrategia360.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: agencyestrategia360.com scores 81 out of 100 (B). 5 checks fail now, 19 are at risk, and 39 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 32 elements on /, /seo, /seo/auditoria-seo, for example .e360-sim__av--user and .e360-sim__src-label. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, for example p:nth-child(4) > a[rel="noopener"][target="_blank"] and figure:nth-child(1) > p > a[rel="noopener"][target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Interactive controls must not be nested
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /seo, /seo/auditoria-seo, for example .e360-serp. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Do not put links or buttons inside other links or buttons.

Plain http redirects permanently to https

Every external link that was checked answered
